page.overview:
Who is Pillbug Devil?

The |Dangomushi no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of pillbugs and worked as a member of Public Safety's Tokyo Special Division 6. He served as a minor antagonist in the Aging Devil arc.

The Pillbug Devil resembles a man and wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform and suit. The top half of his head resembles that of a pillbug, complete with a pair of long, segmented antennae extending from the front. Additionally, the Pillbug Devil dons seven hard, articulated plates that cover the upper portion of his hands.

Not much is currently known about the Pillbug Devil's personality but he is shown to be protective towards his coworkers when attempting to guard them from Pochita.

The Pillbug Devil is summoned to guard the Special Division 6 leader after Pochita makes quick work of the Centipede Devil, Stag Beetle Devil and an unnamed Devil. He warns his allies to get behind him, only to get immediately shredded to pieces alongside his superior.
